title: Ransomware leak-site trackers, crypto sanctions and TRON explorer (batch p1-G09-1)
owner: batch p1-G09-1 (P196 ransomlook, P197 ransomware_live, P356 ransomfeed, P205 crypto_sanctions, P207 tron_explorer)

attributes.ransomware_listing: plain-words leak-site listing status from one tracker: 'listed by <tracker>: N claim(s)' or 'not listed by <tracker> (data as of <date>)' - a miss is never 'not breached'
attributes.ransomware_claims: ransomware leak-site claims matched for the entity: list of {tracker, victim, group, claimed_date, match_type, severity} (actor claims, unverified)
attributes.ransomware_mentions: number of tracker posts that only mention the searched value in their text (a mention, not a victim match)
attributes.ransomware_group_profile: a ransomware group as one tracker sees it: {tracker, name, known, claims_seen, latest_claim, window_days, leak_sites} (actor-controlled infrastructure is never visited)
attributes.sanctions_status: plain-words sanctions-list status of a wallet: 'on the OFAC SDN list (US) as of <date>' or 'not on OFAC lists as of <date>' (never 'not sanctioned')
attributes.ofac_list_hits: OFAC sanctioned-address list entries matching the wallet: list of {asset, list_date, list_sha256, dataset}
attributes.ofac_list_stale: local OFAC address-list copies older than the 3-day freshness limit: list of 'dataset (age)' (stale lists are flagged, never silently trusted)
attributes.onchain_checks: outcome of each sanctions or issuer-freeze check: {check: 'listed' | 'not listed' | 'frozen' | 'not frozen' | 'could not verify (<reason>)'}
attributes.issuer_frozen: stablecoin issuers that froze (blacklisted) the wallet, e.g. 'Tether (USDT on Ethereum)': an issuer freeze, never a sanctions determination
attributes.chainalysis_identifications: Chainalysis sanctions-screening identifications of the address: list of {category, name, description, url}
attributes.token_balances: token balances of a wallet {symbol: amount with unit}; tokens are recognised by contract address, never by symbol
attributes.transfers_seen: number of token transfers read from the explorer pages (bounded: not the wallet's total transaction count)
attributes.top_counterparties: top counterparties of a wallet by stablecoin value: list of {address, usdt_in, usdt_out, transfers, label}
attributes.wallet_labels: explorer labels/tags of a wallet (exchange, scam...) exactly as the explorer publishes them
attributes.lookalike_token_transfers: number of transfers of look-alike tokens (a symbol one edit away from USDT on another contract: address-poisoning spam)
attributes.wallet_status: plain-words on-chain status of a wallet, e.g. 'not activated on-chain (no account record)'

tags.ransomware_claim: a ransomware group's claim on its leak site (an actor statement, unverified until corroborated)
tags.issuer_freeze: address frozen (blacklisted) by a stablecoin issuer such as Tether or Circle: not a sanctions determination

relations.leak_site: victim/organisation/group -> ransomware leak-site onion where claims are posted (hostile: never visited automatically)
relations.leak_site_of: leak-site onion -> ransomware group that operates it (hostile: never visited automatically)
relations.victim_website: company/keyword -> website a tracker lists for a claimed victim (actor claim, unverified)
relations.ransom_contact: ransomware group -> contact printed in its ransom notes (onion, e-mail): hostile, never contacted
relations.group_ioc: ransomware group -> indicator a tracker publishes for the group (hostile: never contacted from the corporate egress)
